subject: Auditor SSO jumpbox access & bridge-letter timing
messages:
From: Paul Grant <paul@prisma-audits.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary trust portal SSO + bridge letter for SOC 2 Type II

Hi Alex / Marissa,

Were scoping the SOC 2 Type II review for ACME Corp covering Jan 1 - Jun 30, 2028. Our audit team (Prisma Audits) needs temporary access to Redwoods trust portal to retrieve evidence and run interactive sessions with your engineering reviewer. To keep this low-friction wed like the following: 

- A one-time SAML SSO link or ephemeral session token valid for a short window (we propose Oct 10 - Oct 13, 2028).
- IP allowlist for our jumpbox (we will connect via a vetted jumpbox; static outbound IPs attached).
- Access: view/download of evidence bundles (system architecture, backup configuration snapshots, change logs, access logs for the audit period).
- A bridge letter confirming there have been no material control changes since the report period and indicating the covered audit window.

Attached is our auditor accreditation for your records (auditor-accreditation.pdf). Please let me know any evidence naming conventions we should ask ACME to provide, and whether your legal team requires a specific template for the bridge letter.

Thanks,
Paul Grant
Principal, Prisma Audits
paul@prisma-audits.com

Attachment: auditor-accreditation.pdf (stub)

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Paul Grant <paul@prisma-audits.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary trust portal SSO + bridge letter for SOC 2 Type II

Paul — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support a short SSO window + IP allowlist and prepare a bridge-letter draft, but a few clarifications so we can route to Security and Legal: 

1) Evidence scope: can you enumerate the exact artifact names (or examples) you need from ACME? We typically segregate logs vs backups vs config snapshots.
2) IPs: please confirm whether the jumpbox IPs are static for the entire window. If they rotate, well need CIDR ranges or VPN termination details.
3) Bridge letter: Redwoods legal likes to review draft language; if you have a preferred template we can work off that to accelerate sign-off.
4) Timing: Legal sign-off on the signed bridge letter usually takes 48-72 business hours. We can expedite if needed, but that affects your go-live schedule.

Operationally, our plan would be: Security will add the IP allowlist to the trust portal ACLs, Product Ops will generate a one-time SAML invite (we can make it require MFA), and Compliance will prepare a draft bridge letter for Legal. We have an internal runbook for "auditor temporary access" (link below) that outlines the steps well take.

Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-443 (internal runbook / tickets)

If you confirm the IP list and the final evidence set by end of day Wed Oct 3, we can meet your Oct 10 start date for an SSO window.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Security Operations, Redwood Inference

Thanks Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming details below: 

- Audit period to cover: 2028-01-01 to 2028-06-30 (same as initial note).
- Evidence set we will request from ACME: "system-arch-v2.pdf", "backup-config-2028-06.zip", "change-log-2028.csv", "access-logs-2028-q1-q2.tar.gz" (file names approximate).
- Jumpbox outbound IPs (static): 34.201.12.45, 34.201.12.46, 34.201.12.47. Ive attached a text file with the list (auditor-ip-list.txt).
- We will connect via our jumpbox and authenticate via SAML — the jumpbox will perform no artifact storage, only an interactive session to retrieve items.
- Earliest preferred issuance for the SSO link: 2028-10-10 02:00 UTC (we can wait for bridge-letter sign-off but would like portal access queued).

If you need a specific bridge template, we can attach one; otherwise were happy to review Redwoods draft.

Best,
Paul

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Paul Grant <paul@prisma-audits.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Oct 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary trust portal SSO + bridge letter for SOC 2 Type II

Paul / team — quick operational update from Redwood Compliance & Security: 

- We have added the three IPs to the trust portal allowlist (34.201.12.45, 34.201.12.46, 34.201.12.47).
- One-time SAML invite has been generated and scheduled to become active at 2028-10-10 02:00:00 UTC; it will expire automatically 72 hours later (2028-10-13 02:00:00 UTC). The invite enforces MFA (TOTP) and is tied to the session recording policy. The invite token is being stored in our ephemeral invite store and was emailed to the auditor directly as "trust-portal-saml-invite.txt" (attached).
- Draft bridge letter (bridge-draft.docx) is attached for your review — Legal is on a 24–48 hour turnaround for signature; well push for same-day signing if you confirm no edits.
- Evidence bundle for the window (read-only) is available here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-evidence-bundle — auditors will have view/download privileges only.

Action items for Prisma: confirm receipt of the SAML invite when it arrives, and ensure the jumpbox uses the listed IPs during the window. If the auditors need elevated access (e.g., hosted DB snapshots), that requires a separate request and additional approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth review.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
